capabilities: Set reminders on TODO list items with inline date syntax
View a list of all reminders across files and jump to the source file
Notify in-app when a reminder is due, with mark-done or postpone actions
Remind from a date stored in a note's properties without a task line
Read reminder formats from Obsidian Tasks, Kanban, and TaskNotes
extras: FAQ states system notifications on mobile (Android/iOS) are not available because Obsidian does not provide that feature; detailed guide content is on external documentation pages.
problem: Obsidian tasks and dated properties are static text, so users get no alert when a due date arrives.

relations.evidence: this plugin also supports following plugin formats. - Obsidian Tasks (e.g. 📅 2021-05-02)
TaskNotes (reminders kept in a task note's reminders property)
If you use the Natural Language Dates plugin, see the guide for how to avoid the @ autocompletion conflict.

summary: Reminder plugin that adds date-based reminders to Markdown TODO items and note properties, with a reminder list and in-app notifications.
